geometry: A white, one-pixel-wide square-cornered inverted U above two hollow rectangular noteheads, on a transparent 16 by 16 canvas. The upper bracket spans x=4–11 and y=7–10; the noteheads span x=2–5 and x=10–13, y=12–14.
limitations: The source is an un-antialiased 16-pixel icon; the square-cornered vector geometry preserves its simple native design.
